title: Comptroller and Auditor-General of India
description: Prescribes form and manner of annual statement of accounts in consultation with the Central Authority

content.name: Comptroller and Auditor-General of India
content.role: Certifies and audits the accounts of the Central Authority; is consulted when the form and manner of the annual statement of accounts are prescribed
powers: audit the accounts of the Central Authority and demand production of books, accounts, vouchers and documents
demand production of books, accounts, connected vouchers and other documents and papers
inspect any of the offices of the Central Authority
